The '''C-227 motivator''' was a type of [[Motivator/Legends|motivator]] for [[Agrirobot/Legends|agricultural droids]]. [[Madel Wharen]] noted that the repair of such a unit was beyond the capabilities of a particular [[Drever Corporation]] executive.
